description:
Get border crossing data at U.S. ports of entry: trucks, personal vehicles, pedestrians, train passengers, containers.
Covers U.S.-Mexico and U.S.-Canada borders. Monthly data by port, state, and measure type.

measure.description: Measure type: 'Trucks' (Commercial trucks), 'Personal Vehicles' (Personal vehicles (cars)), 'Pedestrians' (Foot traffic), 'Train Passengers' (Rail passengers), 'Rail Containers Loaded' (Rail freight containers (loaded)), 'Rail Containers Empty' (Rail freight containers (empty)), 'Buses' (Bus crossings)

port_name.description: Port of entry name: 'El Paso', 'San Ysidro', 'Detroit'

name: bts_border_crossings
